data.revised_prompt:
Create the following asset: Clean four-layer authorization chain architecture diagram, 16:9 landscape.

Main subject:
AstralLight physical dual-card permission chain: four stacked layers.

Composition and hierarchy:
Four horizontal layers stacked top to bottom, each a rounded rectangle with a short label and one-line note, connected by a single downward flow arrow on the left and a return arrow on the right.

Visual treatment:
Clean technical architecture illustration, white background, thin vector lines, flat low-saturation fills, generous spacing, no 3D effects.

Lighting and color:
Muted indigo, lavender, teal, sand, and charcoal on white.

On-image text:
Render only this copy, exactly and verbatim: "L0 Identity Issuance"; "L1 API Gateway"; "L2 Service Middleware"; "L3 Policy Engine"; "dual-card scope validation"; "claims + Redis session checks"; "no identity-card fallback"; "rule-set evaluation, default deny". Language: English. Placement: Layer name centered inside each rounded rectangle; one-line note beneath each name. Hierarchy: Short semibold layer names, smaller regular note text.

Requirements:
- No decorative 3D effects.
- No gradients.
- No numbered stage badges.
- All arrows must have a clear direction.
- No additional text or labels beyond the listed exact strings.
- No watermark or logo.
